cards.title: Blackstone's AI Head Downplays Buildout Debt Fears
cards.body: Blackstone's Jas Khaira says concerns about AI infrastructure debt are overblown. The PE giant remains confident in its AI investment strategy despite market jitters.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Coming November 4
cards.body: Full-day event in Boston bringing together founders across all stages with top VCs and entrepreneurs. Focus on tactical insights for building and scaling companies.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Hits 10M Users, Shopping Leads
cards.body: Meta Muse surpassed 10 million users with shopping and personal productivity as top activities. Growth announced during Q3 earnings call.

cards.title: Recursive Launches Flint, AI-Built Coding Model
cards.body: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI system. Represents early test of self-improving AI.

cards.title: Walmart Welcomes AI Agents While Amazon Blocks
cards.body: Walmart launches new technology enabling AI agents to make purchases on customers' behalf with spending controls. Amazon takes opposite approach by blocking AI agents.

cards.title: OpenAI and Google's Wiz Discover Ancient Security Holes
cards.body: Major security vulnerabilities discovered in PHP by AI research teams. Critical risk due to widespread internet impact.

cards.title: Blacksmith Reaches $1B Valuation After Series C
cards.body: Blacksmith raised $66 million Series C led by Sequoia, hitting unicorn status. Platform helps companies build and test AI code more effectively.

cards.title: Managers Struggle With AI Adoption Work Evaluation
cards.body: Over 50% of managers report difficulty evaluating employee work after AI adoption. Creates headaches for performance management processes.

cards.title: Anthropic Proposes AI Safety Regulation Bill
cards.body: Anthropic pitched policy blocking model release if 50+ deaths could result. Requires judicial permission for federal agencies to block releases.

cards.title: Hugging Face CEO Disputes Netflix AI Documentary
cards.body: Clem Delangue criticized Netflix's 'AI Gone Rogue' documentary for going 'full doomer mode.' Says featured content lacks accuracy.

cards.title: Anthropic's Cloud Partnerships Face Major Strains
cards.body: Anthropic struggles securing compute as cloud providers view it as competitor. Infrastructure spending balloons ahead of planned November IPO.

cards.title: SpaceX AI Business Drives Third Quarter Profit
cards.body: SpaceX reached profitability in Q3 with $4.4 billion net income. AI operations served as primary growth engine.

cards.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio for Biotech
cards.body: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio's team and technology to strengthen Rosalind, its life sciences AI model. Addition supports Rosalind Workbench experiment planning tool.

cards.title: Google Joins Amazon Attacking Nvidia's Dominance
cards.body: Google released developer tool easing PyTorch migration off Nvidia GPUs. Follows Amazon's competitive move challenging Nvidia's stronghold.

cards.title: ChatGPT Adds Chat Lock Privacy Feature
cards.body: OpenAI introduced chat locking for personal conversations and surprise planning. Keeps discussions private when sharing devices with others.

cards.title: Eric Schmidt's Anthropic Stake Grows Significantly
cards.body: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns half as much Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei. Stake positions Schmidt for major wealth increase.

cards.title: Meta Muse Hits 10M US Downloads in 40 Days
cards.body: Meta Muse reached 10 million US downloads in 40 days, joining elite 12-app club. Shows higher user retention than AI rivals.

cards.title: Physical AI in LEGO Era, VC Says
cards.body: Ex-Nvidia VC Amulya Vishwanath compares robotics AI to early computing stages. Predicts incoming 'ChatGPT moment' for robotics.

cards.title: Startup Builds AI Model to Decode Plant Language
cards.body: Electric Plant developed AI translator deciphering plant electrical signals. Innovation enables humans to understand plant communication.

cards.title: Figma Co-Founder Questions MCP Protocol Perfection
cards.body: Dylan Field says MCP isn't a perfect protocol for data sharing. Figma plans supporting multiple standards without full data exposure.

cards.title: OpenAI's Latest AI Models Come to Google Cloud
cards.body: OpenAI is expanding its AI model availability through Google Cloud and Antigravity partnerships. This move makes cutting-edge AI capabilities more accessible to enterprise customers.

cards.title: $15 Billion Ad-Powered AI Startup Used by Doctors
cards.body: A major AI startup valued at $15 billion is already integrated into healthcare systems across the country. The platform uses ad-supported models to power medical applications.

cards.title: Meta Removes 'Train' From AI Commercial Terms
cards.body: Meta updated its commercial terms of service, dropping language about 'training' AI models following backlash. The change reflects growing concerns about AI data usage practices.
